messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — need final release notes and an internal blast for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Pinning decision and rollback criteria needed. Lock RN doc @ 17:00 PT :lock:

mike: Thanks. What's the candidate model/service version? I see both `service-v2.3.1` and `service-v2.4-canary` in the bucket.

olivia: I'm leaning v2.3.1 for stability. v2.4 has a perf regression on long-tail tokens in canary. We can do a limited canary later.

ray: +1 for v2.3.1. If we need to roll forward later we can schedule a microlaunch after canary fixes.

ana: Decision: pin `service-v2.3.1`. olivia please update RN and add known issue note about v2.4 canary perf. Anne to send internal blast. :thumbsup:

product-ops: For internal announcement, want one-line summary + impact matrix (who's affected, rollback plan, contact). Can you add a short snippet we can paste into the staff brief?

ana: Draft snippet:
"Deployment: service-v2.3.1 -> prod
When: Tomorrow 10:00 UTC
Why: performance/stability improvements
Rollback: automatic rollback if error-rate > 5% OR p95 latency increases > 200ms for 10m.
Oncall: @sre-oncall
Contacts: olivia, mike"

mike: LGTM. Add the `deploybot` cue: run `deploybot promote --from=gray --to=prod --tag=service-v2.3.1` and wait for the 5m health-check window. If health-check fails, `deploybot rollback --tag=service-v2.3.1`.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by ana. Staging -> Prod promotion queued for 2026-03-22T10:00:00Z. Health check window: 5m. Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: I will watch dashboards. Can we add a short runbook line for thresholds? I'll paste below.

sre-oncall: Runbook snippet:
```
If errors > 5% in 10m -> escalate to oncall then run `deploybot rollback --tag=service-v2.3.1`
If p95 latency > 200ms sustained for 10m -> rollback
If minor increase in 95th with no functional errors -> open ticket and monitor for 30m
```

olivia: I updated the RN doc and added the v2.4 note + canary follow-up. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/rn/service-2026-03-22

ana: Locking RN doc at 17:00 PT — no further content changes after that unless it's an emergency. If you need changes ping me directly. :rotating_light:

product-ops: I'll prepare the internal blast. Expect draft in #eng-releases by 18:00 PT for sign-off.

ray: One more ask — pin the runtime config `max-concurrent-reqs=120` in the deploy to avoid autoscale surprises.

mike: noted, adding to deploy manifest. I'll also tag the release artifacts.

ana: Thanks everyone. Final checks by 17:00 PT and sign-off by 18:00 PT. Moving to two-hour pre-flight window at 08:00 UTC tomorrow for final health signals. :white_check_mark:
